title: FlowDoc Core Backend Editor Readiness Pass 8h
summary: Execute an eight-hour bounded readiness pass before deeper Editor/frontend implementation, starting by reconciling Core fixture state, proving the Backend owner gate against the actual sibling Core checkout, adding bounded Editor live Backend rich-inline harness evidence, defining the Editor text-block authoring boundary, adding memory-only active text-block island runtime state, wiring that state into the Editor Backend mutation lifecycle, adding an Editor-owned active text-block island commit runner with live Backend proof, adding an Editor-owned node placement readiness matrix, adding an Editor-owned add-node contract builder before visible typing UI, adding the Backend active add-node mutation transport gate with Editor capability parser compatibility, adding the Editor add-node activation harness for active insert contracts behind Backend capability and revision gates, activating the bounded visible Outline add-node UI for Text/Columns insert operations through the same Backend capability and revision gates, adding a bounded visible text-block textarea island that saves the first text inline run through Backend rich-inline mutation and reload proof, and hardening that text-block editing UX with Core v4 line-break normalization, dirty-state cleanup, save-rejection recovery, multiline rows, and live Backend reload evidence, extending Editor text-bearing node coverage so the Outline exposes nested text-block descendants inside columns/table surfaces and opens a bounded textarea for selected nested text through live Backend save/reload evidence, and adding canvas preview text descendant selection so clicking text represented inside columns/table preview surfaces selects the exact editable text-block descendant and visibly highlights the matching Structure/Outline item while ordinary canvas drag/drop and Backend mutation sources remain surface-based and guarded, and adding selected composite preview child visual state so selected text-block descendants represented inside columns/table Preview surfaces appear as selected mini objects while parent surfaces remain context surfaces and authoring/mutation boundaries stay closed, and adding Structure panel large-document navigation/performance safeguards so large Outline lists are windowed around the selected item, group rows can collapse with selected descendants forced open, and small live Backend documents keep all Structure rows and toggles unwindowed while authoring and map-truth boundaries remain closed. and adding a bounded table authoring gate so table, row, cell, and table text selections have explicit blocked facts before table mutation transport exists and adding bounded media and utility node readiness so image, page-break, spacer, divider, and toc insert surfaces are explicitly classified from Core placement and Backend operation capabilities while unsupported operations remain blocked and recording a bounded Overview, History, and Structure UX planning gate that separates Project Control repo-first orientation, Project Control Work History, Editor Structure, and Editor local history before UI implementation
